baseline_scope: Previously accepted mapped-navigation lap, same 60cm windows. Return-start previously ended north without a turn; new return-start adds west-facing readiness, so its added rotation is reported separately.
excluded_attempts: candidate-01: conservative lamp clearance 4.65cm below retained 5cm gate
candidate-02: interrupted during development after return-arc continuity counterexample
candidate-03: successful development lap used to select 2cm terminal tolerance
candidate-04: 8mm terminal tolerance missed endpoint and timed out; rejected, restored 2cm and added bounded overshoot guard
final-01: three successful preliminary laps; terminal retry state subsequently isolated by lap; excluded from final source identity
extended-final-01: interrupted stress trial to apply cross-lap retry isolation
final-02 and extended-final-02: eight raw laps successful; strict review found initial-turn overshoot-guard false positives and 97.952% stress source-pose coverage, so excluded
extended-final-03/continuous-two-laps: explicitly paused by user before a complete lap; retained and excluded; resumed repeat tested in a fresh directory

planning_grid.source: SLAM OccupancyGrid, >=3-frame endpoints and unique-per-frame clear rays registered by camera/wheel/IMU source-time TF; clear requires >=3 frames and >=3 clear votes per hit; supplied lanes separately constrain travel; no SDF collision coordinates

threshold_scope: Project acceptance gates, not official competition scores: position 6cm, conservative post clearance 5cm, vision 8Hz, image age p95 150ms, source pose coverage 98%. Planned post margin strengthened to 6.5cm. Six-corner smoothness limits declared before final matrix.
scope: Eight complete physical laps in seven isolated cases, including two successive laps in one running world, same frozen runtime source. Fixed supplied field, known gallery and lane prior. No claim about hardware, unfamiliar persons, arbitrary starts or persistent-blockage detouring.
